name: ka-mobile-android
description: KA Mobile v2 — Intent Operating System (React + Capacitor)

scripts.sync: vite build && node scripts/sync-assets.mjs && npx cap sync
scripts.sync:android: vite build && node scripts/sync-assets.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: vite build && node scripts/sync-assets.mjs && npx cap sync ios
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:ios: npm run sync:ios && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace KA.xcworkspace -scheme KA -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator
scripts.build:ios:release: npm run sync:ios && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace KA.xcworkspace -scheme KA -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos
